label: Immediate Coastal Zone (0–5 km)
description: Direct coastal margin along the Gulf of Mannar, highest tidal influence and seawater intake access.

label: Near Coastal Zone (5–10 km)
description: Secondary coastal belt supporting large organized evaporation reservoirs and crystal pans.

label: Intermediate Coastal Plain (10–30 km)
description: Flat inland salterns and sub-surface brine extraction facilities in coastal taluks.

label: Inland / Peripheral (>30 km)
description: Dispersed inland salt pans and hypersaline flats away from the immediate shoreline.
